description:
WHAT: Runs the Fairquery Apify Actor sanctions-watchlist-screener: fuzzy-match people/organisations against OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated, EU, UK and UN lists from the official sources (re-downloaded when the cached copy in your Apify account is older than 6 h; every row reports each list's publication date); optional country/DOB filters.
WHEN: KYC/KYB onboarding, vendor/counterparty checks, bulk re-screening. Put all names in ONE call (each call is one run with its own start fee; list loading takes ~2-5 s from the cache, or 10-40 s, up to ~60 s, when lists are re-downloaded).
WHEN NOT: PEP/adverse media, certified compliance decisions. For coverage info use free sanctions_list_sources. Leads that also have an email to validate: trust_screen_lead (one merged decision).
COST: Paid, billed to YOUR Apify account via your APIFY_TOKEN: $0.003 per name + $0.007 per run. 200 names in one call ~ $0.61.
RETURNS: Paged "screening" rows (status potential_match | no_match, matches[] best first, lists_unavailable) or "error" rows. Tool errors: INPUT_EMPTY, APIFY_TOKEN_MISSING, APIFY_TOKEN_INVALID, APIFY_PAYMENT_REQUIRED, APIFY_ACTOR_RUN_FAILED, APIFY_TIMEOUT. Not a certified screening service. Automated fuzzy matching against public lists; false positives and misses are possible. Review every potential match manually and consult official sources/legal counsel before acting.
BEHAVIOR: Results are stable for a given list snapshot. Makes network calls: runs an Apify Actor in your account; latency seconds to minutes (300 s timeout). Up to 10,000 names.
PARAMETERS: names and/or queries: at least one non-empty (the schema marks both optional; neither -> INPUT_EMPTY, not billed). Both may be combined; every entry is billed once, so use names for bare strings and queries when you have country/dateOfBirth/entityType or want your own id echoed. In queries, dateOfBirth removes listed individuals born more than 1 year apart, while country never removes matches (it only sets country_match); entityType "entity" covers organisations, vessels and aircraft. lists: omit to screen all five; a list that cannot be downloaded is reported in lists_unavailable instead of failing the run. minScore: a match is returned only if its 0-100 similarity is >= minScore; 85 balances recall and noise, 90-95 for large batches, 75-80 for transliterated names; it does not change the price. maxMatchesPerName caps matches[] only; match_count still reports all matches. limit/offset only page the returned rows: every call screens and bills all names again (also when only offset changes), so set limit (max 1000) to cover all rows instead of paging.
EXAMPLE: {"queries":[{"name":"Banco Nacional de Cuba","entityType":"entity"}],"minScore":90} -> status potential_match (OFAC_SDN).

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-1000 (default 100). Example: 50

lists.description: Optional, default all five. Any subset of "OFAC_SDN" | "OFAC_CONS" | "EU" | "UK" | "UN" (ids from sanctions_list_sources). Example: ["OFAC_SDN","EU"]

maxMatchesPerName.description: Optional integer 1-100, default 10. Max entries in matches[] per name (best first); match_count still reports the total. Example: 3

minScore.description: Optional integer 60-100, default 85. Minimum 0-100 fuzzy name-similarity score for a match; 90+ = fewer false positives, ~80 = more recall. Example: 90

names.description: Optional if queries is given (at least one is required). 0-10000 plain person/organisation names, 1-300 chars each. Example: ["Acme Trading LLC","Banco Nacional de Cuba"]

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

queries.description: Optional if names is given. 0-10000 {name, id?, country?, dateOfBirth?, entityType?} objects. Example: [{"name":"Ali Khamenei","id":"cust-42","country":"IR","dateOfBirth":"1939","entityType":"individual"}]

country.description: Optional, <= 60 chars. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("IR") or English country name ("Iran"); adds country_match true/false to each match, does not filter

dateOfBirth.description: Optional. Format YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD (pattern ^\d{4}(-\d{2}-\d{2})?$), e.g. "1939" or "1939-04-19"; listed individuals whose birth year differs by more than 1 year are dropped

entityType.description: Optional, one of "individual" | "entity" | "any", default "any". "entity" = organisations, vessels, aircraft

id.description: Optional, <= 200 chars. Your own reference echoed back in the row, e.g. "cust-42"

name.description: Required. Person or organisation name, 1-300 chars, any order/case/diacritics, e.g. "Banco Nacional de Cuba"

name: sanctions_screen_names

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Screen names against OFAC/EU/UK/UN sanctions (paid)
